name: Teanco Video Player Lite
author: Tean

sections.description:
Teanco Video Player Lite lets you add HTML videos, Youtube and Vimeo videos plus audio and images to your website. It can display one of more videos in each player.

Key Features

  • Responsive Layout – Fully responsive and adaptable to any device.
  • Desktop & Mobile Optimized – iPhone, Android, and desktop browsers supported.
  • Lazy Scrolling/Loading – Loads videos only when visible, improving performance. Load only image poster before video is shown.
  • Customizable Size – Set any aspect ratio. Support for both portrait and landscape videos.
  • HTML Video Support – Add video to player.
  • Youtube Support – Add Youtube video to player.
  • Vimeo Support – Add Vimeo video to player.
  • Audio Support – Add Audio Song to player with artwork image.
  • Image Support – Add Image to player with duration timer.
  • Customizable Design – Choose between multiple available skins and change player colors and icons as desired.
  • Share Button – Share video url to many social platforms.

Links

  • Homepage & Docs
  • Demo
  • User Manual

Support

  • For questions or support, open a ticket.

Advanced Features in PRO Version

Upgrade to Video Player Lite PRO to unlock:

  • Unlimited videos: Add unlimited videos and players to page.
  • Quick shortcode generator: Option to use quick shortcode generator to quickly add videos to page and change shortcode parameters dynamically.
  • Live streaming: Support for HLS and MPEG DASH videos.
  • Video subtitles: Attach multiple subtitles to video.
  • Video chapters: Attach WEBVTT chapters to video.
  • Cue points: Add cue point which will trigger at specific video time.
  • Keyboard controls: Control video playback with keyboard controls.
  • Embed player: Embed player to other websites using embed code.
  • Replace WordPress videos: Automatically replace WordPress videos in pages.
  • Advanced Customization: More control over player appearance and behavior.

Add-Ons

  • Video Statistics Addon: Track video statistics in player (plays, downloads…)

Quick Usage

  1. Create new player in Player Manager
  2. Create new playlist in Playlist Manager (add one or more videos into playlist)
  3. Copy shortcode from Shortcodes menu with your newly created player and playlist, example: [apvpl player_id=”1″ playlist_id=”1″]

Shortcode

Basic example:

[apvpl player_id=”1″ playlist_id=”1″]

Upgrade to PRO for More Features

Unlock advanced features like adding unlimited videos to page, using subtitles and chapters with videos. Option to use quick shortcode generator. Option to automatically replace WordPress videos in pages, and much more.

External services

This plugin uses Vimeo Player to play Vimeo videos.

Terms of use https://vimeo.com/legal
Privacy policy https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/articles/12426199699985-Overview-of-video-privacy-settings

This plugin uses Youtube Player to play Youtube videos.
This service is provided by Vimeo https://youtube.com/
Terms of use https://www.youtube.com/static?template=terms
Privacy policy https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks/privacy/

This plugin uses HLS.js to play HTTP Live Streaming videos.

Dash.js is released under BSD license https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/blob/development/LICENSE.md

This plugin uses Threejs.js to play 360 virtual reality videos.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How do I create a video?

Navigate to Video Player Lite > Playlist Manager > Add New Playlist, add your video there and customize settings.

How do I add video player in a post or page?

Navigate to Video Player Lite > Player Manager > Add New Player, customize settings. Go to Shortcodes menu and copy shortcode with your desired Player and Playlist you created.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes. Video Player Lite is fully responsive and optimized for touch.

Can I use it with external media?

Yes, it supports many external media types (YouTube, Vimeo, Google Drive, etc.).
